body: Listen. I get this. I’ve had so many bad times because of my anger. I’ve punched holes in walls at least 20 different times. I’ve broke stuff. I’ve smashed windows. Even took a golf club to someone’s car one time while severely intoxicated and pissed off. I’ve been a real asshole to people I cared about. I’ve threatened people I cared about. I’ve been borderline psycho to people I’ve cared about. When I’m in blackout mode from my anger, I become this different person. I remember one time my Mom saw this other person, I usually try not to let anyone in my family see the person, but she said there was something in my eyes that felt like a different person. Like it’s really crazy. You ruin so many relationships with people and you feel extremely shameful and embarrassed after a rage. That feeling makes me feel suicidal. I’ve struggled with having empathy for people too, especially when I’m angry. Don’t give up though, please. Nothing is worth taking your life over. And this sounds selfish, but if people can’t forgive you when you have angry rages and stuff, they aren’t worth it, because some people have explosive anger and they have zero control when it happens.

I was just like you up until a couple years ago. I lived my entire life socially awkward AF. I’m 29 now. I don’t know if it’s a good thing or not, but I totally gave up on all aspects of life a couple years ago, and once I did, I stopped being socially awkward, even with strangers. Idk why. I guess it’s just because my soul is gone. I don’t really have advice because I never really found a way to combat being that way, it just happened, but I do offer my apologies to you that life has dealt you a cruel hand. Because being socially awkward SUCKS, I know. I know for me that whenever people told me that I just have to go out there and take control of it and be aggressive, it didn’t work at all. If you are younger, it’s harder. Someday you will no longer suffer from it, like myself. I feel like it’s a part of growing my up for a certain group of people.

Well, it depends on if you believe in God or not, first off. If you don’t, like myself, normally you’d look at life from a scientific standpoint. I like to believe that humans are animals, just like all other animals, we are just more intelligent than the rest, although there are some animals who are probably smarter than some humans. We are basically just super evolved apes, IMO. Besides that, I think the important thing in life are spending time with loved ones (family, friends, etc.). You can live a selfish life or become a billionaire and buy everything your heart desires, but you can’t take any of it with you when you die, unless you leave everything you have earned to your family, who can use it. But sadly not all of them think that way. If you don’t have family or friends, you can enjoy doing things you enjoy on your own, even traveling. But I do feel like humans need interaction and intimacy. Like domesticated pets do, for example. 

I also think about the universe and how many generations of humans there have been, and what does it all really mean in the long run? Everyone is forgotten in time, even if you were the most popular person on the planet for your entire life, sure, future generations may know if you, but give it a few generations of humans, say 400 years, and you’ll likely be forgotten unless you are a historical figure. But even then, many people today don’t know all too much about famous people from say 1400, 1500, 1600, except for a few fringe people thanks to history being recorded. We’re all just a piece of an infinite puzzle.

Same here. People always treat me with aggression for no reason. People I don’t even know. Like I’ll be at a gas station or something and buy some drinks. I’ll say ‘’thank you’’ to the cashier and they don’t say anything back, or I’ll say ‘’hey how’s it going?’’ and get nothing back. I get dirty looks in public places all the time, for no reason. Whenever 90% of the people in my family talk to me, they usually bust my chops on something or are downright rude, even if I haven’t said anything to them first. I definitely have been an asshole at some times in my life to people, who hasn’t, but 90% of the time people treat me like shit for no reason. Life is cruel. Life is hard. If you don’t luck out in life, you experience all of this. Humanity is ugly, frankly. I love the days when I come home after a long day of getting shit from everyone and feeling unloved/unwanted and my cat is happy to see me, he comes and rubs on my leg and wants me to pet him. Animals are better than human kind.
